## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The new `status` line shortens the revision differently from `history` and `completed`, which its own docstring says it should match. Fix this before merge so operators can match a running deployment to its history entry.

## Changes
Adds `status(revision, attempt)` and `attempt_label(attempt)` to `app/display.py`, which print a "Running:" line with the deployment's attempt number. It also adds two tests for them in `tests/test_display.py`.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/display.py:14 — correctness — Shorten the revision to 12 characters, as `history` does — For `REVISION = "0123456789abcdef..."`, `status` prints `Running: 0123456 (attempt 2)` while `history` prints `History: 0123456789ab`, because line 14 uses `revision[:7]` and `history`/`completed` use `revision[:12]`. The docstring at line 13 says "using the same identifier as history." — Operators can't match a running deployment's status line to its history or completion line by revision. — Fix: Use `revision[:12]`, and extend `test_running_status_contains_attempt` to compare the full string, since its `startswith`/`endswith` checks pass for any revision length.
